$comment: Blind rater N card. Anchors: ../eval-fun/docs/FRAMEWORK.md section 3, idle boundaries: docs/FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md. One quoted observation per axis. bot stays na (caps applied later). Criterion + idle probes answered before awarding. Read only RATER_PROMPT.md, RATING.md, FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, FRAMEWORK.md 1-3, the template, tools/browser.mjs and the head of eval-fun's fun-score.mjs (usage comment) — no PLAN.md, research, CUT docs, other cards or source. Audio: no window.__audio on this (non-dev) build and the harness cannot be listened to, so audio is unassessed everywhere. Screenshots and running notes under the raterN scratchpad (shots/001_first, 006_watch11 = first death, 009_edit_drink_unknown = first edit, 117/118 = return screen, 124 = first edit after return, 169 = third death).

absences: 8h simulated via ?dev=1&absent=8h after 40 min of cold play (03:46-04:26), then 22 min on return (04:28-04:50); seed 137, fresh lineage
horizon.$note: 16 online runs: 14 in the default 'fights' mode (each ~40-70 s of screen time), 2 in 'fast' mode (~10 min each). 3 deaths read (goblin D4, poison D5, gas D11), morgue opened on all three. 8 edits of my own (R1 drink unknown; foes>=3 to corridor row; foe:heavy throw unknown row; depth>=5 bank row; depth>=8; foe:thief attack thief; on see captive free captive; return threshold 30%->10% then deleted) plus 2 offered patches tapped (hp<50% return, forecast 'try: attack boss') and 2 cards bought (kite archers, thief guard).

criterion.delayedRecall: same-day: I sent my curious fighter down with return set to 10% instead of 30%, and two ogres on D7 hammered him to 8/42 before the warlord on D8 put its shields up; my hp<50% heal rule fired there and took him back to 28. He walked the Fens past eels on D9 and D10 with my kite-archers card doing the shooting, and on D11 his curious streak gambled an unknown gilded scroll that turned out to be recall. That sent him home with $237 banked at 100%, my deepest run, and I bought four unlocks on the back of it.

$probes.wantedToComeBackBeforeSeeing: Mildly yes: I wanted to know whether the thief-guard card would finally stop monkeys stealing my $40 potions, and whether D8 was passable. I did not expect anything to happen offline since I had never seen an auto-send.
$probes.return_whatDidYouComeBackTo: '11 RUNS · D8 BEST · ◆+10 · 0 DEATHS', eight 'returned $157 ... keeps 60%' rows, 'rested 261m', a STALL line 'R2 return ended 10 runs at D8', a new boss 'goblin warlord boss · buffer · summoner · telegraph' with 'counter: attack boss', fighter L4 ↑2, ★5 ↑3, and a reel like 'The lock took him to 6 HP; the chokepoint landed; returned.'
$probes.return_whatDidYouDecide: Tapped the forecast row 'D9 0% · try: attack boss', bought +1 row so I could keep it, bought thief guard and supplies 3→5, dropped my own thief rule, and bought mail plus three heals with the $807; forecast went from D9 0% to D9 42%. First meaningful action was well under 30 s.
$probes.return_wouldYouRatherHaveStayed: No. Eleven identical-looking returns at 60% keep is more than I would sit through; the STALL summary was the right compression. I would have liked the supplies not to be 0/5 on return despite owning auto: restock.
$probes.attribution_howDidTheLastRunEnd: I deleted the return rule to see how deep he could go; he explored D11 at 6/42 with no rest rule and a gas bloat took the last hit — 'gas · D11 · 1 hp short · gap'. That was my decision; the patch 'hp < 20% → rest · reach +54%' named exactly the row I had not written.
$probes.attribution_pronounCount: Retelling above uses I/my 8 times, 'he/his' for the agent 5 times.

axes.proxy: time-to-first-rule-edit; misread rate on the trace
axes.note: Present: forecast bars re-rolled within a second of every edit ('D5 24% → 70%' when I put drink heal above return), 'yours: 2 of 3 rows · 1 combo', a '⌐ chokepoint' label appeared between my corridor row and attack row, death header 'goblin · D4 · 2 hp short · 5 unknown unused · gap'. Friction that keeps it at adequate: the pixel font rendered 'STOLEN $2' as 'STOLEN ?2'; I could not reconcile gold ($166 before a run that 'returned $36', $58 after); five runs of 'R1 no item' in the trace never said the potions were stolen (only the reel's 'A thief snatched the heal potion ×2' did); 'class: rogue' bought for ◆0 changed nothing I could find; HP fell 26→13 and 38→18 under the travel interstitial with nothing shown; forecast still read 'D9 0% · try: attack boss' for ~5 s after I had added that rule.

Strong: switching R1 to 'drink unknown' raised D5 from 54% to 66% but the top cause row turned to 'fire 24% poison 24%', and that rule did kill heir 2 ('Gambled: poison potion'); 'depth ≥ 5 → bank' instantly showed 'D6 0% ±1' so banking for the rogue unlock cost all depth; return at 30% vs 10% was a real choice (0 deaths in 11 offline runs vs D11 and a death). Named lapse: forecast noise of ±14 made row-ordering decisions unreadable (moving corridor above attack moved D5 52→58, within noise), and 'card: kite archers' landed below 'attack nearest' where it could never fire until I noticed.

I went from dying on D4 with the preset ('R1 unknown item') to D11 in an hour by learning that traits act 'trait first', that rule order is everything, that cards 'take a row', that thieves eat supplies, and that a card row must sit above the catch-all; the game kept naming the next lesson ('STALL R2 return ended 10 runs at D8', 'try: attack boss'). Named lapse: the potion mystery took five runs to solve because the trace only says 'R1 no item' and survivor runs keep just five turns of trace.

Stakes I chose were visible on the run header — '$118 · death: lose all' vs '$57 · keeps $34 · return at 30%' — and the run-11 return at '6/38' after a spectral blade hit at 12 was a real near miss; the bail button was there at 5/36 and I chose not to press it. But once the return rule was in, most watched runs and all 11 overnight runs resolved with '0 DEATHS' and 'keeps 60%', so the outcome was rarely in doubt until I removed it myself.

axes.proxy: frame time; events per minute at 1x
axes.note: Visual only (audio unassessed: no window.__audio on this build, harness inaudible). Taps answered instantly and the big pixel fighter with 'R2 ATTACK MONKEY' / 'OGRE WINDS UP' callouts read well; but in most fight frames the foe was off-screen (screenshot 022: 'R3 ATTACK OGRE' with no ogre visible), fights are 1-3 s text tickers ('−3 goblin', 'goblin slain'), and the map goes fully black behind the return sheet.

axes.proxy: death-cause entropy; distinct situations per run
axes.note: Situations that changed what I configured: 'A thief snatched the heal potion ×2' (bought thief guard), 'goblin conjurer: summoner' with spectral blades, 'bloat: gas … it swells … −3 burst', 'Warlord rallies / shields up' on D8, 'D9: the Fens · Met a eel · eel: water', 'A cry from the dark: a captive, chained' (wrote free captive; morgue later said 'Freed the captive. It followed.'), a 'The vault opens: choose one' room, and a gambled recall scroll that banked $237. Named lapse: runs 6-10 were the same D4 ogre-plus-archer wall five times in a row.

The set is recognisably mine — the chronicle even christened heir 2 'the chokepoint fighter' after my corridor combo, and my final set reads boss / heal at 50% / kite card / free captive / thief guard / attack — but the editor counts only 'yours: 3 of 7 rows · card R4 first': two of the working rows are prebuilt cards and one is an offered patch, and every safe set converged on the same heal-then-return spine.

Run 15 has a turn I can retell without notes (return at 10%, ogres to 8/42, 'shields up', heal to 28, 'The gilded one: recall. Gambled: recall scroll. Banked $237.'), and the reel writes lines like 'The lock took him to 6 HP; the chokepoint landed; returned.' and 'Krim the goblin is avenged.' Named lapse: the overnight reel repeated 'The lock took him to 17 HP; the chores explored; reached D7.' three times nearly verbatim, and I never learned what 'the lock' is.

axes.proxy: run length; check-in length; dead time at 1x
axes.note: In-run: 'fights' mode gives ~1 min per run at 1x with an event every 3 s ('−3 gas', 'ogre winds up', 'R2 · drink heal'); 'fast' mode showed two minutes of 'pick up / descend' on D3 with nothing happening. Check-in: read death → tap edit → forecast → send took 2-5 min and always ended on a chosen 'send'. Cadence: 20 min was one rest, 8 h was '11 RUNS … rested 261m' plus a STALL summary — distinct experiences. Named lapse: the two biggest exchanges of my best runs (38→18 HP between D8 and D9) happened under the travel interstitial where fights mode shows nothing.

axes.proxy: share of deaths with a matched-rule trace
axes.note: Every death gave cause, margin and the rule or gap in one screen: 'goblin · D4 · 2 hp short · 5 unknown unused · gap' with the last five turns ('trait retreat 2 3', 'R2 attack nearest 1 2') and the per-rule reason 'R1 unknown item'; the morgue added 'R2 no path' and 'R1 not in view · R2 no item · R3 card passed · R4 locked cond'; patches carried 'survives 100% · base 25% · reach +25%'; the next heir was ready instantly ('rest 20m · send skips'). Named lapse: death 2's headline blamed '6 unknown unused · gap' when the trace shows my own 'R1 drink unknown' firing twice was the killer ('Gambled: poison potion').

I set goals the game did not ask for: banked at D5 to earn 'class: rogue ⊘ bank once', wrote 'on see captive → free captive' after the reel's captive line, and deleted the return rule to see the floor. The dungeon itself is a straight descent and three rule-set slots ('fighter 6', '2 0', '3 0') were the only alternate routes.

Within-run: kit lines like 'sword +1 / mail +1 / heal potion' and 'fighter +216 · L4'. Between-run: ◆ unlocks bought roughly one per run (+1 row, verb: throw, two cards, supplies 3→5), the action picker grew from 'attack nearest' to 'attack telegraph / attack heavy / throw fire' as facts were learned, the shop grew from 'leash $30' to twenty identified items, a bestiary ledger, trophies 'home:10 · studied all warrens · slain:500', ★0→★5. Automation: 'path: bones', 'auto: restock', and cards that bundle four rules. Named lapse: 'auto: restock' left supplies '0/5' after the overnight and 'class: rogue' bought for ◆0 had no visible effect.

Visual only. Dark olive brick tiles, a large hand-drawn fighter sprite, chunky pixel-font callouts and a clean monospace camp; the Fens arrived as a name and eels rather than a new look. I would not sit in it doing nothing, and 'STOLEN ?2' (missing $ glyph) is a visible blemish.

axes.proxy: offline yield vs active; decisions pending on return
axes.note: The 8 h absence returned '11 RUNS · D8 BEST · ◆+10 · 11 RETURNED · 0 DEATHS', 'rested 261m', a STALL card naming my own rule as the wall ('R2 return ended 10 runs at D8'), a new boss with a named counter, L4 and ★5, and the forecast row 'D9 0% · try: attack boss' was tappable — I acted within 30 s and had ◆13 and $807 to spend; 11 runs in 8 h against 16 in an hour active kept active play worth more. Named lapse: for ~6 s the page showed the stale camp with an 'OFFLINE' tag before the summary appeared, and supplies came back '0/5' despite auto: restock.

axes.proxy: share of deaths attributable to a rule the player wrote
axes.note: Two of three deaths trace to my hand: heir 2 died because my 'hp < 30% → drink unknown' fired at hp 10 ('Gambled: poison potion') after the forecast had warned 'poison 48%', and heir 3's run 27 died because I deleted the return rule and wrote no rest rule; the overnight STALL blamed 'R2 return' by name and the reel credits rows ('R1 drank', 'the chokepoint landed'). Named lapse: traits act before my rules ('cowardly → retreat', 'curious → read ?' gambling a confusion potion I never told him to drink), and for five runs a thief nullified my R1 with no rule-level explanation.
